intent: Delete the dead .hippo/ memory store: 161 tracked files and 3.2M of episodic entries for a tool that is no longer installed and whose entries were never once retrieved.
scope: NON-GOAL: any behaviour change; nothing reads this directory
changes: git rm -r .hippo and removed it from disk. No .gitignore entry was needed after all: the handoff anticipated one for hippo.db (untracked only because *.db is ignored), but with the whole directory gone there is nothing left to ignore.

verification.evidence: No matches — every one of the 158 episodic entries had retrieval_count 0. The store was written to and never read from.
2026-05-28 — last write was almost three months ago.
Not installed; nothing can write to or read this store.

Only prose references in the handoff and evidence artifacts. The one code hit, digital_wellbeing/leechblock_defaults.json, is the blocked domain 'wordhippo' — a coincidental substring, not a dependency.

risks: Irreversible only in the sense that any deletion is; the full contents remain in git history and can be restored with git checkout <prev-sha> -- .hippo.
rollback: git revert this commit, or git checkout 309f4c8d -- .hippo to restore the directory alone.
After rollback validate: git ls-files | wc -l returns to 1336.
